== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The early card retrieves the stolen card’s destiny value. The January 2003 rules identify this action and explicitly carry through the original card’s uniqueness. The remaster requires a stealable object and provides optional retrieval of 3 Force. The added printed bullet records the inherited uniqueness.
